description: External (non-LCM) tools the LCM workspace depends on. Consumed by Set-GitRoot.ps1 (adds addToPath directories to the Machine PATH) and Test-ExternalTools.ps1 (readiness check). Paths are absolute install locations; the workspace root itself is only ever read from the Machine registry value Git_Root.

tools.name: Everything
tools.role: Instant file-name and content search (es.exe CLI)

tools.name: BeyondCompare
tools.role: Review gate and Giant Review (BComp.com / BCompare.exe)

everythingIni.note: Content search (content:) only works when content indexing is on and covers the workspace and the file types below. Changes show up in the index with a delay of usually under one second.
